modules.title: 一段源码怎样被规则扫描并定位问题

items.title: 检查的是源码形状和约定
items.text: 规则可以发现未使用变量、危险模式或团队约定不一致的写法，通常不需要启动完整应用。结果会定位到文件和行，适合在提交前迅速修正。

items.title: 静态通过不等于运行正确
items.text: Lint 不会替你点击按钮、等待网络或确认数据库写入。它应当放进 CI 作为一道早期检查，再由测试和验收证明实际行为。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: Lint 不是单元测试、构建或用户验收。它分析源码规则而不执行完整程序；通过说明没有触发当前规则，并不证明功能、性能或真实环境配置正确。

lessonPractice.title: PR 的 Lint 已通过，但点击保存后页面没有任何提示。什么判断最准确？

options.label: 源码规则没有发现问题；还要实际操作或跑测试检查保存流程和反馈
options.feedback: 对。Lint 通过不能证明按钮事件、网络请求或页面状态正确。

options.label: Lint 通过就说明保存功能已经验收完成
options.feedback: 静态检查没有执行用户操作，不能提供这种证据。

options.label: 既然还会出错，就不必运行 Lint
options.feedback: Lint 仍能及早发现另一类问题，只是不应被误当作全部验证。

en.title: A PR’s lint passes, but clicking save shows no feedback. What is the most accurate judgment?

options.label: Source rules found no issue; operate or test the save flow and feedback next
options.feedback: Correct. Passing lint does not prove button events, network requests, or page state are right.

options.label: Passing lint means saving is fully accepted
options.feedback: Static checking did not execute a user action, so it cannot supply that evidence.

options.label: Since errors can still happen, do not run lint
options.feedback: Lint still catches another class of issues early; it simply should not be mistaken for all verification.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请为项目开启并修复 Lint 报告的未使用变量和未处理 Promise。把 Lint 放进 PR 检查，但完成后仍实际测试保存按钮：点击、等待、成功和失败提示都要确认。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Enable and fix lint reports for unused variables and unhandled promises. Put lint in PR checks, but still test the save button afterward: click, wait, success feedback, and failure feedback all need confirmation.

learning.assumes: You have seen an editor show a warning or error beside a code line.
learning.outcome: You can use lint as source-rule checking and know it cannot replace runtime and user-journey verification.

modules.title: How source code is scanned by rules and gets a located issue

items.title: It checks source shapes and conventions
items.text: Rules find unused variables, risky patterns, or team-inconsistent code without starting the full application. Results point to a file and line for quick pre-commit correction.

items.title: Static passing is not correct running
items.text: Lint does not click buttons, wait for networks, or confirm database writes. Put it in CI as an early check, then use tests and acceptance for actual behavior.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Lint is not a unit test, build, or user acceptance. It analyzes source rules without executing the full program; passing only says current rules did not trigger, not that behavior, performance, or real configuration is correct.

distinctions.label: Unit test
distinctions.text: {c:lint} finds suspicious source patterns without running the complete program. A {c:unit-test} executes one code unit and checks its actual result.
